title: The Brood King

comms: [OVERWATCH] Readings are coming from the island's heart. The survey team went in before us; see if they left anything.

objectives.text: Follow the King's trail through the Tangle (the Caldera is {caldera_dir})
comms: [OVERWATCH] Look at the size of those tracks. Follow them. And watch the trees, the locals don't like visitors.
[OVERWATCH] That gate's older than anything we've seen. Whatever's behind it, Operative, it knows you're coming.

objectives.text: Return to the ship (Recall, or the beach shuttle)
comms: [OVERWATCH] ...It's down. The King is down. The swarm on Kessar is finished. Come home, Operative.

debrief: [OVERWATCH] The Brood is broken. Every hive in the Kessar System is dying off. You did that.
[INES RUHL] It's quiet. The chatter's gone. All of it. ...Almost all of it. There's one channel I can't place. Three notes, over and over.
[OVERWATCH] Noted. Get some rest, Operative. Belt Claim 7 and the Halcyon System are open on your star map.
